text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While staying in Del Mar for a few days to watch the BC...
Today was a sightseeing day."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun is going to be my guide today. I can't wait♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, just enjoy yourselves for now!
Yeah, just make sure to have fun first!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan is going to be my guide today. I can't wait♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, just enjoy yourselves for now!
Yeah, just make sure to have fun first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Placing yourself in an unfamiliar environment takes a greater toll on you than you realize. It's best to get used to it as much as possible for next year."
choice_data_list: While we're at it, let's get used to the atmosphere around here.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaaaale... Hehe, the scent of the tide...
It's so pretty~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Still, there's a grandness to it... It feels quite different from the seas back in Japan!"
choice_data_list: Apparently that area over there is a hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Really? Let's go♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Wonderful!
It really is a hidden gem! It's so quiet and feels so good~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as the research indicated, it's uncrowded and quiet.
Managing nerves and fatigue before the main event is crucial,
so bringing her here for a quick refresh seems like a solid plan.
choice_data_list: (Next is the route to the hotel and the travel time...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There are quite a few Japanese restaurants around here...
This place has set meals, soba... and even sushi!
Everything looks so delicious~!
choice_data_list: It's a chain with locations all over America.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then we don't have to worry
no matter where the Breeders' Cup is held♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before a big race, managing your condition with familiar meals as much as possible is essential. There's a limit to how much you can cook yourself, so places like this are a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Then for this year~ maybe I'll go with the sushi and soba combo! How about you, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, just whatever set meal is fine—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Then for this year~ maybe I'll go with the sushi and soba combo! How about you, Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, just whatever set meal is fine—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The menu has a rough nutritional breakdown... This place was definitely a good pick. Factoring in this menu, I can plan out next year's diet...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's so lively here.
There are plenty of tourists just like us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There really is quite a lot of foot traffic downtown.
It will probably be even crazier when the BC is held.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To avoid any unexpected situations next year,
I need to keep the surrounding traffic and congestion
firmly in mind...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, say aah.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, say "aah~".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)
choice_data_list: Mmph, it's so co—... Wait, it's delicious...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. An ice cream truck came by over there,
so I bought some. Enough for both of us♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look down at the colorful, triple-scoop ice cream cone just handed to me.
It has the exact same flavors as the one she's holding.
The sweet taste of strawberry spreads across my palate.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Eating alone is lonely. So have some too, Trainer-kun, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Eating alone is lonely. So have some too, Trainer-chan, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Weren't we supposed to go sightseeing together?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, you told me to "have fun," but...
If we aren't "together," it's meaningless. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You told me to 'have fun,' Trainer-chan, but...
it's meaningless unless we're 'together.' ...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To support her challenge. To make sure everything was
perfectly prepared, I was desperately pushing myself...
only to end up making her worry about me instead.
choice_data_list: Sorry. Still got a long way to go, huh...
Sorry. I've still got a lot to learn...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
You know, I feel so fulfilled right now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You're always trying your absolute best.
...Giving it your all, just for me."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You always give it your all.
...Always trying your hardest, for me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It feels so warm...
It makes me think, 'Ah, everything's going to be okay.'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Let's definitely see it together.
From the peak of the BC—
a view overflowing with love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...For now! We're sightseeing together today!
First, let's enjoy our matching ice creams♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ice cream we shared while strolling through the streets of Del Mar was so sweet...
and had a comforting, heartwarming taste.
